title: Notification bubbles are stacked improperly when more appear in quick succession than can fit on the screen at once
line: When many notifications arrive at once, the ones that don't fit wait their turn instead of appearing alone at the top of the screen.
explanation: positionPopups() places popups and hides any that would fill more than 80% of the screen. But when a popup was created, the applet called positionPopups() and then set the popup visible unconditionally, overriding that decision. In a burst, a popup created while the others were still being sized could end up shown far above the stack, at the top edge of the screen. The change drops the unconditional show, so positionPopups() alone decides which popups are visible.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: Don't show popups that don't fit on screen

positionPopups() hides popups past the part of the screen they may fill,
but each new popup was then made visible anyway, so a burst of them put
extra popups far above the stack; leave visibility to positionPopups().

BUG: 510647

media.caption: Master: 50 notify-send calls; popups 1-7 stacked, then a gap and popup 11 alone at the top edge
Fixed: same 50 calls; popups 1-7 stacked evenly, nothing shown above them
Fixed: after the first batch closes, the waiting popups (8-14) take their place, evenly spaced

review.text: Removing the unconditional object.visible = true after positionPopups() in Globals.qml fixes the exact root cause: positionPopups() already sets visibility for every popup and hides those exceeding the 80% screen-fill limit, so the trailing assignment was forcibly showing the last queued popup in a burst at the top of the screen. The 1-line change is minimal, safe, and clearly proven by the before/after screenshots.

reviews.text: Removing the unconditional object.visible = true after positionPopups() in Globals.qml fixes the exact root cause: positionPopups() already sets visibility for every popup and hides those exceeding the 80% screen-fill limit, so the trailing assignment was forcibly showing the last queued popup in a burst at the top of the screen. The 1-line change is minimal, safe, and clearly proven by the before/after screenshots.

positionPopups() already decides visibility per popup (hiding everything past popupMaximumScreenFill), and onObjectAdded overrode that with an unconditional object.visible = true, which is exactly how an overflow popup ends up shown alone near the top edge as in the reporter's and Nate's screenshots. Dropping the override is the minimal, correct fix in the right place; the early-return paths of positionPopups() (no visual parent, invalid screen rect) are re-run via onVisualParentChanged/repositionTimer, so new popups are not lost. Before/after shots with Nate's 50x notify-send loop show the stray popup gone and even spacing, and after-2 shows the queued popups appearing when room frees. Commit message, line and explanation match the one-line diff.
